observations: Photo 0: Black UPS unit with 'BLUE GATE' embossed branding, blue vertical panel with power button and three indicator lights, sitting on tiled floor.
Photo 1: Same unit from side/top angle, showing power cord with plug attached, 'BLUE GATE' logo visible on front panel.
No screen, display, or model number plate visible in either photo.
No indicator lights shown illuminated in either photo.
No battery compartment, output sockets, or rear panel view shown.
Seller provides no photo of unit powered on or under load.

claims.evidence: Photos show the physical unit exists, but availability/transaction status cannot be confirmed remotely.

risks.risk: Unit may not power on or hold charge (battery dead/faulty, common in used UPS units)
risks.proof: Video clip of unit powered on with a load connected, showing indicator lights active and sustaining power after mains unplugged

risks.risk: Internal battery may be missing, swollen, or need replacement
risks.proof: Photo of opened battery compartment showing battery condition

risks.risk: Output sockets or internal wiring could be damaged
risks.proof: Clear photo of rear panel with output sockets and any damage visible

risks.risk: Capacity/VA rating unknown, affects value tier
risks.proof: Photo of rating label/sticker (often on side or bottom) showing VA/W rating
risks.if_unproven: priced at lowest comparable tier for this brand

proof_requests: Video of the UPS powered on, charging, and running a load (e.g., a lamp) after mains is unplugged, showing it sustains power
Photo of the rating label/sticker showing VA/W capacity and model number
Photo of the battery compartment opened, showing battery condition
Photo of the rear panel with output sockets
response.reason: Brand (Blue Gate) is clearly readable from both photos, matching the two comparable listings which are explicitly sold as faulty; seller gives no proof of working condition, so the item must be priced at worst case as faulty, consistent with the comparables.
